address: 345/1-2 Airport Road, Ban Pet, Mueang Khon Kaen, Khon Kaen, 40000, Thailand
bio: Arrivals and departures are better with a stopover at this simple restaurant in front of Khon Kaen Airport. For more than two decades, Prapai’s friendly owners have been serving authentic Isan dishes made with fresh local ingredients that change with the season. To experience traditional Isan cooking, try deep-fried sour fish or the off-menu Somtum in fermented fish sauce with salted crab....
